verdict.rationale: The Needle README says you can declare a shape, pass in messy text, and get typed fields back, and that "the decode grammar guarantees the output parses". That is grammar-constrained structured output. A community tester also reports getting a clean JSON doc from a multi-intent request. The support rests on a single brief README line, with no detail on schema format, custom grammar authoring, or how it is exposed through the serving API. missing for 10: documentation of JSON Schema or custom grammar (e.g. GBNF) support, grammar or response_format options in the OpenAI-compatible serving API, enum/value-constraint enforcement details, independent hands-on corroboration of the parse guarantee.
